text:
vivian: rolled latency-aware batch-splitting + regional cost-routing to a 6% canary (prod) at 15:47 UTC. short note: aim to reduce p50/p95 for short bursts while shifting low-value traffic to cheaper pools. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
omar: can you summarize the runtime knobs?
vivian: two runtime actions: 1) batch-splitter now separates tiny requests (<10 tokens) and coalesces them opportunistically for up to 5ms; 2) weight-based cost router routes non-SLA traffic to cheaper GPU pools unless latency SLO would be violated. Both guarded by per-route policy.
lee: bench numbers please?
vivian: ran 50m live-replay + synthetic microbursts. For short requests (<16 tokens): p50 8.2ms -> 3.6ms (~56% rel), p95 46ms -> 28ms (~39% rel), p99 240ms -> 200ms (~17% rel). Overall token spend down ~14% due to routing cheap traffic + fewer filler tokens.
lee: any quality/latency regressions for premium routes?
vivian: no regressions on SLA routes. Observed a small transient p99 in one cheap-pool AZ when we underprovisioned prefetch buffers; patched by increasing buffer cap for that pool. No customer impact.
omar: can you paste the feature flags/config you flipped? makes it easier for QE.
vivian: pasted snippet in thread (not a nested object, just text):
```
feature: latency_aware_split
split_threshold_tokens: 10
coalesce_max_ms: 5
routing: {policy: "cost_weighted", sla_routes_exempt: true, cheap_pool_pct: 0.35}
```
lee: perf-run id and dashboard?
perf-bot: perf-run id perf_2026_07_18_1547 - dashboard https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/canary/1822223333 - traces + cost breakdown attached. :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: current canary nodes: 10 nodes (6% traffic). logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/1822223333
omar: rollout plan?
vivian: staged: 6% -> 25% (30m) -> 60% (1h) -> 100% with these gates: 1) premium-route p99 must not increase >5%, 2) cheap-pool p95 embed latency < 2x baseline, 3) cost reduction >5% at 60%. rollback flags: disable latency_aware_split or set cheap_pool_pct=0.0. I'll create rollout ticket and checklist.
lee: add a short simulated cheap-pool overload test in the smoke harness so we catch that prefetch buffer underprovision again.
omar: ops window 02:00 UTC ok? @lee
lee: ok.
vivian: TL;DR: latency-aware splitting + cost routing -> big short-request p50/p95 wins and ~14% token cost reduction; one transient cheap-pool buffer issue fixed; staged rollout scheduled. will upload full artifacts and the reproduction harness after final flip. :tada:
